  }else if(kind==='turkishDoor'){

  }else if(kind==='windowSingle'){
    graphic=`<rect x="62" y="34" width="106" height="92" rx="4" fill="#2168b2"/><rect x="74" y="46" width="82" height="68" fill="#bfe5ff"/><rect x="62" y="76" width="106" height="8" fill="#2168b2"/><rect x="54" y="126" width="122" height="14" rx="5" fill="#d4d9df"/>`;
  }else if(kind==='windowDouble'){
    graphic=`<rect x="56" y="32" width="118" height="94" rx="4" fill="#2168b2"/><rect x="66" y="42" width="45" height="74" fill="#bfe5ff"/><rect x="119" y="42" width="45" height="74" fill="#bfe5ff"/><rect x="112" y="42" width="8" height="74" fill="#2168b2"/><rect x="66" y="78" width="98" height="6" fill="#2168b2"/><rect x="48" y="126" width="134" height="14" rx="5" fill="#d4d9df"/>`;

    graphic=`<rect x="48" y="34" width="134" height="90" rx="4" fill="#2168b2"/><rect x="60" y="44" width="54" height="70" fill="#bfe5ff"/><rect x="116" y="44" width="54" height="70" fill="#cdeaff"/><rect x="108" y="44" width="8" height="70" fill="#2168b2"/><path d="M84 126 L102 126" stroke="#2168b2" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M128 126 L146 126" stroke="#2168b2" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="44" y="126" width="142" height="14" rx="5" fill="#d4d9df"/>`;
  }else if(kind==='windowFixed'){
    graphic=`<rect x="60" y="34" width="110" height="92" rx="4" fill="#4b83c3"/><rect x="72" y="46" width="86" height="68" fill="#d8f0ff"/><path d="M86 54 L144 108" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity=".65" stroke-width="6"/><rect x="52" y="126" width="126" height="14" rx="5" fill="#d4d9df"/>`;
  }else{
    graphic=`<rect x="58" y="46" width="114" height="74" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#8a93a4" stroke-width="8"/><rect x="70" y="58" width="90" height="50" fill="#eaf2f7" stroke="#b0b8c5" stroke-width="2"/>`;
  }
  const svg=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 230 230"><rect width="230" height="230" rx="28" fill="#ffffff"/><g>${graphic}</g><text x="115" y="176" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#334155">${dims}</text><text x="115" y="205" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#1f2937">${label}</text></svg>`;
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,'+encodeURIComponent(svg);
}


let v99LibraryPointerDrag=null;
let v99SuppressLibraryClickUntil=0;
function v98WireWholeCardDrag(card,def,isArch=false){
  if(!card||card.dataset.v99Drag==='1')return;
  card.dataset.v99Drag='1';

  card.addEventListener('pointerdown',ev=>{
    if(ev.button!==undefined&&ev.button!==0)return;
    if(ev.target.closest('.editLibBtn,.touchDragHandle'))return;
    if(!pxPerCm)return;
    v99LibraryPointerDrag={
      pointerId:ev.pointerId,def,isArch,card,
      startX:ev.clientX,startY:ev.clientY,dragging:false
    };
  });

  card.addEventListener('pointermove',ev=>{
    const d=v99LibraryPointerDrag;
    if(!d||d.pointerId!==ev.pointerId)return;
    const dist=Math.hypot(ev.clientX-d.startX,ev.clientY-d.startY);
    if(!d.dragging&&dist>7){
      d.dragging=true;
      libraryDragActive=true;
      panDrag=null;
      mainScroll.classList.remove('panning');
      d.card.classList.add('v99Dragging');
      createTouchDragGhost(d.def,d.isArch);
      positionTouchGhost(ev.clientX,ev.clientY);
      try{d.card.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId)}catch{}
    }
    if(!d.dragging)return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    positionTouchGhost(ev.clientX,ev.clientY);
    mainScroll.classList.toggle('touchDropReady',pointInsideCanvasClient(ev.clientX,ev.clientY));

    // Keep the map stationary while placing catalogue pieces.

  },{passive:false});

  const finish=ev=>{
    const d=v99LibraryPointerDrag;
    if(!d||d.pointerId!==ev.pointerId)return;
    v99LibraryPointerDrag=null;
    if(!d.dragging)return;
    v99SuppressLibraryClickUntil=Date.now()+350;
    ev.preventDefault();ev.stopPropagation();

    if(pointInsideCanvasClient(ev.clientX,ev.clientY)){
      const p=clampPointToCanvas(clientToCanvasPos(ev.clientX,ev.clientY));
      addItem(d.def,p.x,p.y);
      pendingFurnitureDef=null;mode='select';updateInteractionCursor();
      setStatus(`تم سحب وإفلات ${d.def.name} في المكان المحدد`);
      if(isIPadLayout())setSidebarOpen(false);
    }
    d.card.classList.remove('v99Dragging');
    panDrag=null;
    mainScroll.classList.remove('panning');
    removeTouchDragGhost();
    setTimeout(()=>libraryDragActive=false,80);
  };
  card.addEventListener('pointerup',finish);
  card.addEventListener('pointercancel',ev=>{
    const d=v99LibraryPointerDrag;
    if(!d||d.pointerId!==ev.pointerId)return;
    v99LibraryPointerDrag=null;
    d.card.classList.remove('v99Dragging');
    panDrag=null;
    mainScroll.classList.remove('panning');
    removeTouchDragGhost();
    setTimeout(()=>libraryDragActive=false,80);
  });

  card.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
    if(Date.now()<v99SuppressLibraryClickUntil){
      ev.preventDefault();ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }
  },true);
}
function appendArchitectureGroup(title, defs){
  if(!defs.length)return;
  const head=document.createElement('div');head.className='archGroupTitle';head.textContent=title;archLibrary.appendChild(head);
  defs.forEach(def=>{
    const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='archCard';d.draggable=false;d.style.position='relative';
    d.innerHTML=`<div class="archThumbWrap"><img class="archThumb" src="${archPreviewData(def)}" alt="${def.name}"></div><b>${def.name}</b><span>اسحب إلى الخارطة</span><button class="touchDragHandle" type="button" aria-label="اسحب إلى الخارطة">⠿</button>`;
    v98WireWholeCardDrag(d,def,true);
    const h=d.querySelector('.touchDragHandle');h.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>startTouchLibraryDrag(e,def,true));h.addEventListener('pointermove',moveTouchLibraryDrag);h.addEventListener('pointerup',endTouchLibraryDrag);h.addEventListener('pointercancel',endTouchLibraryDrag);
    d.onclick=e=>{if(e.target.closest('.touchDragHandle'))return;if(!pxPerCm){alert('عاير القياس أولاً.');return;}pendingFurnitureDef=def;activateWorkingTool('place');setStatus(`المس مكان وضع ${def.name} على الخارطة — ستبقى الأداة فعّالة حتى تختار أداة أخرى`);if(isIPadLayout())setSidebarOpen(false);};
    archLibrary.appendChild(d);
  });
}
function buildArchitectureLibrary(){
  archLibrary.innerHTML='';
  appendArchitectureGroup('الأبواب', architecture.filter(def=>def.group==='doors'));
  appendArchitectureGroup('الشبابيك', architecture.filter(def=>def.group==='windows'));
  appendArchitectureGroup('الفتحات', architecture.filter(def=>def.group==='openings'));
}
function uniqueIds(arr){return [...new Set((arr||[]).filter(id=>items.some(it=>it.id===id)))];}
function getSelectedIds(){
  selectedIds=uniqueIds(selectedIds);
  if(selectedId&&items.some(it=>it.id===selectedId)&&!selectedIds.includes(selectedId))selectedIds.push(selectedId);
  if(!selectedId&&selectedIds.length)selectedId=selectedIds[selectedIds.length-1];
  return selectedIds.slice();
}
function setSelection(ids,primary=null){
  selectedIds=uniqueIds(ids);
  selectedId=primary&&selectedIds.includes(primary)?primary:(selectedIds[selectedIds.length-1]||null);
  selectedMeasureId=null;selectedMapLabelId=null;
}
function clearFurnitureSelection(){selectedId=null;selectedIds=[];}
function clearMapLabelSelection(){selectedMapLabelId=null;}
function currentMapLabel(){return mapLabels.find(x=>x.id===selectedMapLabelId)||null;}
function isItemSelected(id){return getSelectedIds().includes(id);}
function selectedItems(){const ids=new Set(getSelectedIds());return items.filter(it=>ids.has(it.id));}
function furnitureGloballyLocked(){const t=document.getElementById('furnitureLockToggle');return !!(t&&t.checked);}
function canEditItem(it){return !!it&&!it.locked&&!furnitureGloballyLocked();}
function visibleFurniture(){const t=document.getElementById('furnitureLayerToggle');return !t||t.checked;}
function visibleMeasurements(){const t=document.getElementById('measureLayerToggle');return !t||t.checked;}
function visibleMapLabels(){return !mapLabelLayerToggle||mapLabelLayerToggle.checked;}
function measureArrowsVisible(){return !measureArrowsToggle||measureArrowsToggle.checked;}
function furnitureSummaryVisible(){return !furnitureSummaryToggle||furnitureSummaryToggle.checked;}
function visibleBackground(){const t=document.getElementById('bgLayerToggle');return !t||t.checked;}
